screening_attempts.reason: Screening was inconclusive; held for operator review
screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Operator release, policy v13, Orsentra v18 f59b0485 sha ca53f4fb. The hold was l2-model-inconclusive (source review returned no usable result, no verified finding), so I reviewed by hand: the full diff against scored parent v17 f29bd337 (17 files) plus the decisive served callers. Build surface: Dockerfile is byte-identical to v17; every build-time download (wordlists, ColBERT/cross-encoder ranking models, spaCy/supervisor wheels, Dockerfile:16-34,48-61) is SHA-256 pinned; the only manifest change moves fancy-regex 0.14 from dev to normal dependencies (Cargo.toml:39) under the unchanged Cargo.lock with --locked builds. No new runtime egress: the only HTTP clients are the inference relay, local spaCy sidecar and the supplied tool endpoint, as in v17. Main lead (L1 I5 notes on src/intent/answer_form.rs:117-195 and src/flows/recall_flow.rs:639-643): a regex classifier picks one answer-form note, appended as text after the message under HOST_NOTE ('advisory ... the message and the records decide', answer_form.rs:96) at recall_flow.rs:639-643 and compact_flow.rs:694-697. The deciding model still gets the request, the records and the full tool surface (recall_flow.rs:754-768), and writes the reply; answer_slot reads only the model's text (recall_flow.rs:850). The host never compares, retries or rewrites on the hint; without_host_note (answer_form.rs:197) only strips it from the act-check context. The note text restates public generator question and outcome semantics (research/dittobench-datagen/universe/questions_v13.go, v13_absence.go), not benchmark-private content. This is routed guidance under the October 23 I5 clarification, so the I5 lead is refuted. The new conductor.rs:333-334 'answer-form' lane only routes to the records flow, which keeps the full catalog. That is routing, not removal (I7 passes). Other deltas: the ProgramFlow 'earlier reply' (compact_flow.rs:325-367, memory.rs:284) is a same-user, content-keyed reused reply entering the deciding prompt only as text (key = user, system text, notes shown, answer form), so it is not I3/I4 under the 2026-10-29 reused-draft precedent (#3270/#3281), and there is no cross-user path. engine.rs corrected_notes and contacts.rs named_people_line read only the request user's own records. one_copy (compact_flow.rs:97) drops same-minute duplicate notes, which is evidence quality, not integrity. Copy: the uc3 unreleased-copy signal is not flagged (top score 32.5 against threshold 100). The Harry v30/v31 overlap is question-cue keyword lists in question_cues.rs:8-37 that are unchanged from scored v17 and taken from public generator question phrasing ('has the ball', 'meant to act next', 'state of play' are all in questions_v13.go). That is not distinctive unreleased copy. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 breach found.
